lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a semi-regular grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal blob rows, creating high-contrast grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing lower contrast relative to the primary flank blobs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated appendage is attached to the superior margin of the first dorsal fin, creating a localized high-contrast silhouette against the fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density field of micro-blobs concentrated towards the distal trailing edges, with a significantly higher spatial frequency than the lateral flank patterning.
